faq.q: How do I install MARVEL SNAP on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for MARVEL SNAP and check the developer is Second Dinner before tapping Install. It needs Android 7.0 or newer. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from Second Dinner and may be altered, so the safest way to play MARVEL SNAP is the official listing.

faq.q: How do you play MARVEL SNAP?
faq.a: Each game lasts six turns across three locations. Play cards to locations and win two of the three by having more power there. Snapping doubles the stakes for cubes.
Yes. It's free on Google Play. You can buy gold, passes and bundles, but cards are earned by playing and levelling your collection.

faq.q: What does Snap mean in MARVEL SNAP?
faq.a: Snapping doubles the cubes at stake when you think you'll win. Your opponent can retreat to lose fewer cubes.
